qt: to the Commission Lynn Boylan (The Left) Subject:

Anti-Muslim hatred is growing across Europe and this requires a coordinated response to protect Muslims in Europe and ensure that they can live their lives in dignity with the full enjoyment of their civil rights. The Commission currently does not have a stand-alone strategy to counter anti-Muslim hatred. Can the Commission outline: 1.
Why it does not have a definition of anti-Muslim hatred or racism and why no strategy on anti-Muslim hatred has been published?
What the situation is in terms of resources afforded to the Coordinator on combating anti-Muslim hatred, in real terms and in comparison with other similar positions?
How it intends to respond to the anti-Muslim resolution adopted by Parliament in October 2026?1
